pinwheel: The red blades turn around the green centre; the wooden handle stays still.
pinball-table: The red ball moves along the board, and a red flipper swings.
gantry-hoist: The crank turns as the green basket rises and lowers.
electric-carousel: The three horses travel around the centre on the turning round deck.
pneumatic-claw: The wooden jaws close and reopen as the red rods pivot and the syringe rod moves.
drawing-rover: The rover turns, its wheels rotate, and a dark circular line shows beneath it.
wind-racer: The red wheels turn beneath the wooden chassis and sail.
crank-dragon: The dragon’s two wings flap as the wheel and crank turn below.
animation-drum: The slotted dark cylinder turns, carrying the red line drawings around its pale inner surface.
star-projector: The red wheel turns beside the box. The view moves across to pale stars on a dark screen, then returns to the box.
ribbon-spinner: The pink wheel turns while a red section travels around the dark loop.
open-window: A green-sleeved hand enters from the right holding a green-and-pale pinwheel. It tilts the pinwheel forward, returns it upright, then withdraws.
flying-whale: The red pinwheel turns above the frame, which rises a little and lowers again.
ending: The red pinwheel moves to a hand on the left. A star appears above the machine on the right. The machine finishes with the star, and the hand holds the pinwheel.
